Marissa / team —

I'll take the run-of-show and the fallback/rollback owners table. Draft outline (will upload < 2 business hours):

1) Pre-cutover (T-48h checks): health checks, credentials, KV cache warm, perf smoke test owner (Acme oncall)
2) Cutover (T0, 20–30 mins): quiesce traffic, model swap, verification script run (Redwood SE lead: Sergio)
3) Post-cutover verification (T+15m, T+60m): correctness checks, perf baseline, rollout to additional capacity
4) Rollback criteria: >5% error spike OR SLO latency >2x baseline for 2 consecutive minutes (rollback owner: Sergio; Acme rollback owner: platform oncall)
5) Escalation path & Slack/phone roster (primary/secondary owners)

Owners (initial):
- Cutover owner (execute swap): Sergio Alvarez (redwood)
- Acme verification owner: platform oncall@acme-corp.com
- Rollback owner: Sergio Alvarez (primary), Alex Porter (product decision)
- Procurement questions: Sam Li (procurement)
- Security signoff: Jordan Price (security)

I'll attach the 1-pager and a trimmed runbook extract in ~90 minutes.
